model.description: THE ONE canonical derivation of a node's direct-child Folder units by EITHER parentage scheme — parent-link (model-store collection children, no location: model.parent===nodeRef) OR location (physical dir children under dirRel). Reused by BOTH the dir: userDirs merge (server.ts:1805) AND the rawbin:diagram collection branch (server.ts:1813) = ONE derivation, TWO call-sites (R40.81 DRY, no 2nd path). This is what makes a store-only Folder added to a model collection actually RENDER (R40.92).
